answers.core: Because it is easy to implement signals like the ones of AnimatedSprite
answers.workaround:
```gdscript
extends Node2D

var lifetime

func _ready():
	lifetime = $Explosion.lifetime
	$Explosion.emitting = true

func _process(delta):
	lifetime -= delta
	if lifetime < 0:
		queue_free()
```

title: Make Particles emit a signal when all particles finished
